errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt die Terminpreise für die Sommerlieferungen im Marktgebiet des Trading Hub Europe (THE) im Zeitverlauf von 2025 bis 2029.
errors.evidence: The description treats two separate line charts as a single chart. The image contains two distinct charts: one for "Sommerlieferungen" (summer deliveries) from 2025-2027 and another for "Jahreslieferungen" (annual deliveries) from 2026-2029. The description incorrectly merges their features and time ranges.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse stellt die Jahre 2025, 2026, 2027 und 2029 dar
errors.evidence: This description of the x-axis is a conflation of the two separate charts' axes and is factually incorrect. The first chart's x-axis is 2025, 2026, 2027. The second chart's x-axis is 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029. The description omits the year 2028 entirely.
The description states the starting price for summer deliveries in 2025 is 43 Euro/MWh. The chart clearly shows this value is much higher, at approximately 49 Euro/MWh.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie stellt die Terminpreise für die Sommerlieferungen dar, beginnend bei 43 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2025 und bis zum Jahr 2029 auf 29 Euro/MWh abnehmend
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line for summer deliveries extends to 2029. The chart for summer deliveries (left) only goes up to the year 2027.

errors.text_span: Die zweite Linie, die in Grau dargestellt ist
errors.evidence: The description claims there is a second line represented in gray. Both lines in both charts are blue. There is no gray line in the figure.

errors.text_span: und bis zum Jahr 2029 auf etwa 30 Euro/MWh abnehmen, wobei der Preis im Jahr 2029 bei etwa 30 Euro/MWh liegt.
errors.evidence: The description states the price for annual deliveries in 2029 is about 30 Euro/MWh. The chart (right) shows this value is lower, at approximately 27 Euro/MWh.
The prompt asks for a description of each line including its marker shape. The description fails to mention that both lines use square markers.
